Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 2014
ACT IX OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN SEA FISHERIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Sea Fisheries Ordinance, 1971 (Balochistan Ordinance No. IX of 1971)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th
February, 2014]
No.PAB/Legis: V (12)/2014, dated 17-2-2014.---The Balochistan Sea Fisheries (Amendment) Bill, 2014, (Bill
No.10 of 2014), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 1st February, 2014 and assented to by the
Governor, Balochistan on 14th February, 2014 is hereby
published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the Balochistan Sea Fisheries Ordinance, 1971 in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Balochistan Sea Fisheries (Amendment) Act,
2014.
(2) it shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 9, Ordinance No.IX of 1971

ACT IX OF 2014
ACT IX OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN SEA FISHERIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Sea Fisheries Ordinance, 1971 (Balochistan Ordinance No. IX of 1971)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th
February, 2014]
2. Amendment
of section 9, Ordinance No.IX of 1971.---In the Balochistan Sea
Fisheries Ordinance, 1971 (Ordinance No. IX of 1971), hereinafter referred as
the said Act, in Section 9, for the second proviso the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
"Provided
further that fishing craft/trawler operating with the banned fishing gear/net
or without valid fishing license shall also be liable to confiscation along
with the banned fishing gear/net; and on conviction the banned fishing gear/net
shall be destroyed in the presence of a Magistrate, while the fishing
craft/trawler shall be auctioned through wide publicity in leading
newspapers".

Omission of section 10, Ordinance No.IX of 1971

3. Omission
of section 10, Ordinance No.IX of 1971.---In the above said Act, section 10 shall be omitted.
